audit.whatIsWrong: The chart on this page reads Skill, Mundo, Mundo, Skill, Skill, Mundo, Mundo. The packet level chart reads Mundo, Skill, Mundo, Mundo, Skill, Mundo, Skill, and every whys[] line on this same page agrees with the packet, not with the chart above it.
audit.why: whys[0] says your regen beats her level 1 (Mundo), whys[1] calls level 2 a coin-flip (Skill), whys[3] says you hold prio and walk her down at 4-5 (Mundo), whys[6] calls late skill-dependent (Skill). Four rows contradict their own explanation text.
audit.corrected: L1 Dr. Mundo, L2 Skill, L3 Dr. Mundo, L4-5 Dr. Mundo, L6 Skill, first item Dr. Mundo, 2+ items Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as 'the lane flips to walk at him', which overstates the spike, and it ignored the ordering the mirror audit already established.
audit.why: Maximum Dosage is 120s and it does win long fights, but her Glacial Prison (120/105/90) only converts if Mundo's passive has already been spent. The mirror page states the same order from her side: burn the passive with Permafrost, then ult. Stated from your side, that means level 6 is even, not a flip.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stays Skill; the why now names the passive as the reason her ult does not simply win.

audit.whatIsWrong: Permafrost was tracked as if it were the cast to fear, Mundo's passive was never mentioned in any field, and spikes[2].text called Frost Armor a damage source.
audit.why: Permafrost is 1.5s and 20 mana — it is not a cooldown you can wait out. It only stuns a target at maximum Frost stacks, and the stacks come from Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5, 600 range), so Winter's Wrath is the real tell. Mundo's passive resists the first Immobilizing effect and drops a cannister that heals him and cuts the passive's cooldown when he walks over it, so her first stun, knockup or ult is absorbed. Frost Armor deals no damage: it grants Armor, Magic Resist and slow immunity out of combat, which is what actually blanks Infected Bonesaw's slow until you have damaged her.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t now name Winter's Wrath as the tell, state Permafrost's 1.5s/20 mana, and state that the passive eats the first stun. spikes[2].text now names Frost Armor's slow immunity instead of phantom damage.
sources: brief enemyKit (Fury of the North, Winter's Wrath, Permafrost)
